note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md (2026-11-28): ? pictures chosen from 30 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088). Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God and the angel are not pictured; Abraham, Sarah, Hagar and the others are only ordinary people of today, seen from behind or small. Fixed recurring objects: Abraham's tent is a small plain weathered tan canvas tent on a simple wooden pole frame; the oak is one huge old oak with a broad gnarled trunk and a wide dark-green crown; the spring (Genesis 16) is a small spring of clear water welling into a shallow stone-rimmed pool in dry stony wilderness; the well is a plain round well ringed with rough fieldstones with a wooden beam, rope and bucket.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning; (2) write picture ideas for each; (3) judge them; (4) make the top two for each slot as real pictures and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Yahweh appears to Abram at ninety-nine: walk before me and be blameless; Abram falls on his face; a new name, Abraham, a multitude of nations and the land as an everlasting covenant.
The covenant is to be kept through the generations, and circumcision is its sign in the flesh of every male of the house; whoever breaks it is cut off.
Sarai becomes Sarah and will bear a son; Abraham laughs and pleads for Ishmael; God names Isaac, blesses Ishmael and goes up.
On that very day Abraham circumcises Ishmael and every male of his house, as God had spoken.
